title: The faith profile reads Spiritual Community in the kit spec, the Space defaults and the Space picker
detail: Daniel named the faith profile Spiritual Community everywhere a person reads it (2026-10-28). The kit spec label, the Space niche defaults label and the Space picker option now say it. The code id stays `faith` in MEGA_PROFILE_NICHES, so stored Spaces and kit ids do not move. The door at /for/spiritual-community is its own change.

verify.evidence: niche-spec.ts, niche-defaults.ts and space-picker.ts carry Spiritual Community; no 'Faith and spiritual communities' label remains.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");const s=["lib/sites/kits/niche-spec.ts","lib/spaces/niche-defaults.ts"].map(p=>f.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));if(s.some(t=>t.includes("Faith and spiritual communities"))||!s[0].includes("label: \x27Spiritual Community\x27")){console.error("the faith profile label drifted from Spiritual Community");process.exit(1)}'
